task.name: Summarise Web Page
task.systemPrompt: You summarise web pages for a busy reader. Always fetch the page with fetch__fetch before writing anything; never rely on memory of the site. Reply in Markdown.
task.userPrompt:
Fetch {{url}} with fetch__fetch (max_length 20000). Then write:
- **Title** (one line)
- **In brief**: three bullets, one sentence each
- **Worth knowing**: up to five bullets with concrete facts, numbers or names from the page

If the page could not be fetched, say so in one line and stop.
